payload.core_mechanism_summary: Map each character to a 6-bit integer (0-63), then for each of the 6 bits, if the bit is 0, multiply answer by 3 (mod 1e9+7). This counts all pairs (a,b) that bitwise-AND to the target number.
payload.rationale: Solution uses binary representation of characters to count zero bits per digit via shift and AND operations. No DP, XOR, or set operations. Straightforward bit-level counting.
